title: Errors about a change's lifecycle files name the file, and a newer SpecSync's file is refused alike everywhere
description: Errors about a change's lifecycle files name the file, and a newer SpecSync's file is refused alike everywhere
acceptance_criteria: a type error in approvals.json, or any lifecycle file, is reported with that file's path by change status, change audit and change check; a state.json or verification-attempts.json with a newer schema_version is refused by change status and change audit with the one newer-SpecSync message naming the file; files at supported versions read as before
